In his first comments since the Yankees lost to the Rays in an ALDS sweep, Yankees owner Hal Steinbrenner cited the offense as one of the reasons for yet another early postseason exit for the Bombers.

Steinbrenner was asked what changes the Yankees have to make to “get over the hump.”

“I was disappointed, frankly, with the offense throughout the course of the year as a whole,” Steinbrenner said Wednesday morning.

“As a whole, they were very inconsistent and for long periods of time. This has been twice now where the offense hasn’t lived up to their end of the bargain and got the job done. The offense was a big disappointment for me and it has to be better.”

Steinbrenner went so far as to call the Yankee offense “detrimental.”

He admitted that losing star sluggers Aaron Judge and Giancarlo Stanton for over 80 games certainly affected them — with Judge not playing in the postseason — but he stated that he and the Yankees will be evaluating everything “from the top” when figuring out where their offseason priorities lie.
news.content:
از پوشش ما در نتایج جستجوی خود بیشتر مشاهده کنید. هال اشتاینبرنر، مالک یانکی ها، در اولین نظرات خود از زمانی که یانکی ها به ریس در یک رفت و برگشت ALDS باختند، این توهین را یکی از دلایل خروج زودهنگام فصل بعد برای بمب افکن ها ذکر کرد. از اشتاینبرنر پرسیده شد که یانکی ها باید چه تغییراتی را برای "غلبه بر قوز" انجام دهند. اشتاین‌برنر صبح چهارشنبه گفت: «صادقانه بگویم، من از این توهین در کل سال ناامید شدم.» در مجموع، آنها بسیار ناسازگار و برای دوره‌های زمانی طولانی بودند. اکنون دو بار بوده است که تخلف تا پایان معامله انجام نشده و کار را انجام داده است.
اشتاینبرنر تا آنجا پیش رفت که جرم یانکی را "مضر" خواند. او اعتراف کرد که آرون جاج و جیانکارلو استانتون در بیش از 80 بازی، ستاره‌های باخت را تحت تأثیر قرار داده است - با این که جاج در فصل بعد بازی نمی‌کند - اما او و یانکی‌ها وقتی بفهمند اولویت‌های خارج از فصل کجاست، همه چیز را «از بالا» ارزیابی خواهند کرد.

news.originalContent:

Aday Mara needed just one game to suddenly make the Thunder seem much better suited to handle Victor Wembanyama this season.

The Thunder’s 7-foot-3 rookie had a strong debut Tuesday and helped Oklahoma City hold the Spurs’ phenom to a career-worst shooting night in a 116-104 road win in a Western Conference finals rematch.

Mara scored seven points while adding two rebounds and one block in 12 minutes, including a pivotal third-quarter sequence where he blocked Wembanyama and then scored on the other end.

OKC really drafted the Wemby stopper 😭Mara just OWNED Wemby on BOTH ends pic.twitter.com/jtXIMwcS8m

“He was awesome,” Thunder coach Mark Daigneault said. “Great poise, great impact. He had probably one of the stretches of the game — it’s a critical thing there when he blocked the shot and went down and finished the other end. He didn’t seem overwhelmed by the atmosphere of the game.

“I’m not really surprised by how he’s performed in preseason. I think he’s proven to be a very impactful player. His minutes weren’t high tonight but his impact was. Clearly, somebody we trust, put him in that game and we’re only going to trust him more after seeing how he performed in a high-level game.”

The Thunder and Spurs are both stocked with talent and seem destined to clash in the playoffs for years to come, meaning they both can build rosters with the other team in mind.

In last year’s conference finals, Wembanyama had his way against Oklahoma City to the tune of 27.3 points per game, 10.9 rebounds per contest and 2.7 blocks per game to eliminate the reigning champions.

Oklahoma City’s big-man duo of Chet Holmgren and Isaiah Hartenstein proved helpless in the series, with Holmgren particularly being ineffective.

The Thunder responded by using the No. 12 pick in the draft to select Mara out of Michigan after he helped the Wolverines win the national title.

Adding the 262-pounder suddenly gave Oklahoma City another weapon to throw at Wembanayama, and he provided encouraging results Tuesday.

His highlight sequence came in the third quarter with Oklahoma City leading 82-70 when Mara blocked Wembanyama while he attempted to score on an alley-oop.

Moments later, Mara scored on an alley-oop.

Mara told a Spanish outlet that he received a game ball for his efforts.

“I’m happy it’s official now,” he told CARTV, as reported by eurohoops.net. “I felt good playing, and I felt like I helped the team, so I’m happy.”

The trio of Mara, Holmgren and Hartenstein ultimately held Wembanyama to 13 points on 1 of 12 shooting to allow the Thunder to exact revenge for last year’s playoffs exit.

“There’s always a variance to it,” Daigneault said of slowing down Wembanyama. “I thought he missed shots that he can normally make from the floor. I thought Chet did a great job on him. I thought Mara did a great job on him the possessions he had tonight.

“I thought we collectively had the right amount of response to him.”
news.content:
پوشش بیشتر ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. آدی مارا تنها به یک بازی نیاز داشت تا ناگهان تاندر برای مدیریت ویکتور ویمبانیاما در این فصل بسیار مناسب‌تر به نظر برسد. تازه‌کار 7 فوتی تاندر روز سه‌شنبه اولین بازی قدرتمندی داشت و به اوکلاهاما سیتی کمک کرد تا پدیده اسپرز را در یک مسابقه وسترن در بدترین تیراندازی حرفه‌ای-101 در مسابقه‌ای که در یک مسابقه وسترن 6-101 برد، برگزار کند. مسابقه برگشت مارا در 12 دقیقه در حالی که دو ریباند و یک بلاک اضافه کرد، هفت امتیاز به دست آورد، از جمله یک سکانس مهم در کوارتر سوم که در آن ویمبانیاما را مهار کرد و سپس در سمت دیگر گلزنی کرد. OKC واقعاً دروازه بان ومبی را درافت کرد 😭مارا فقط مالک ومبی در هر دو پایان بود
مارک داگنو مربی تاندر گفت: "او فوق العاده بود." «تعادل عالی، تأثیر عالی. او احتمالاً یکی از کشش‌های بازی را داشت - وقتی ضربه را مهار کرد و پایین آمد و انتهای دیگر را تمام کرد، یک چیز مهم است. به نظر نمی رسید که او تحت تأثیر جو بازی قرار بگیرد. "من واقعاً از عملکرد او در پیش فصل تعجب نمی کنم. فکر می کنم او ثابت کرده است که بازیکنی بسیار تأثیرگذار است. دقایق او امشب زیاد نبود، اما تأثیر او بود. واضح است که کسی که ما به او اعتماد داریم، او را در آن بازی قرار داد و ما تنها پس از دیدن عملکرد او در یک بازی سطح بالا، بیشتر به او اعتماد خواهیم کرد."
تاندر و اسپرز هر دو سرشار از استعداد هستند و به نظر می رسد که قرار است برای سال های آینده در پلی آف به مصاف هم بروند، به این معنی که هر دو می توانند با در نظر گرفتن تیم دیگر فهرستی را بسازند. در فینال کنفرانس سال گذشته، ویمبانیاما دوباره راه خود را داشت.

You’ve seen it before — the skincare commercial where someone joyfully splashes water on their face, usually right before the screen flashes the words “hyaluronic acid” in bold.

That signature water imagery? It’s not just for show. It perfectly captures what the best hyaluronic acid serums are designed to do: hydrate, plump and refresh your skin like a tall glass of water for your face.

So, what is hyaluronic acid, really? Despite the slightly intimidating name, it’s not a harsh chemical. In fact, it’s a naturally occurring substance found in your skin, joints and eyes. As a powerful humectant, hyaluronic acid draws moisture from the environment and locks it into your skin — making it an essential ingredient in many moisturizers, serums and even lip balms. The result? Smooth, supple skin that looks healthier and more hydrated.

Whether you’re wondering how to use hyaluronic acid, whether hyaluronic acid causes acne, or how it compares to niacinamide, there’s no denying the ingredient’s versatility. It’s loved by dermatologists and skincare lovers alike, and the benefits of hyaluronic acid go far beyond hydration (think: improved skin texture, minimized fine lines and even soothing support for sensitive or acne-prone skin).

To help you navigate the best options on the market, we’ve rounded up top-rated products — from the best overall hyaluronic acid serum to a gentle lip balm, nighttime serum and more. No matter your skin type or concern, there’s a hyaluronic acid solution for you.

“Hyaluronic acid is a natural substance found in our skin that helps keep it moisturized and plump,” Rachel Nazarian, MD, board-certified dermatologist at Schweiger Dermatology Group in NYC, told the New York Post. “Because of its ability to draw and hold water, it’s referred to as a ‘humectant moisturizer’ — and keeps skin moisturized throughout the day, [minimizing] the appearance of fine lines and superficial wrinkles.”

Ahead, find the alluring, barrier-repairing serums, face masks, lip balms, and lotions that’ll bring your skin back to life (when used consistently, that is). Once you begin dousing your face and body with HA, you’ll be in for a dewy, glowing-from-within treat.

The Drunk Elephant B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum is an incredibly moisturizing, humectant-forward serum that wears many hats in its formulation. For one, it helps minimize the look of fine lines, helps reverse and alleviate the impact of my dry, flaky skin and essentially floods my skin with nourishment. It’s the crème de la crème of hyaluronic acid serums, namely for its ability to mask away dullness and conquer even the driest of regions on the face.

Leave it to me — I’ve reviewed all of Drunk Elephant and the brand goes beyond its photo-worthy matte white lotions and potions with a fun, neon cap. The magic is what lies inside and, in this case, it’s hydration.

Drunk Elephant’s B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum is packed with pineapple ceramides and provitamin B5, the latter an additional humectant that helps improve skin barrier function. And, don’t let the fruity notes in the ingredients worry you if your skin is sensitive; it holds virtually zero fragrance.

Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Pineapple ceramide, Provitamin B5 | Size: 1.69 ounces |  Pairs well with: Drunk Elephant Lala Retro Whipped Cream ($64)

The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Serum is a popular, lightweight serum designed to hydrate and replenish the skin. With a 2% concentration, this serum provides a balanced level of hydration without overwhelming the skin, fitting the bill as one of the best hyaluronic acid serums we tested. Its gentle formula makes it suitable for all skin types.

The addition of Vitamin B5 (panthenol) enhances the skin’s barrier function, promoting healing and reducing irritation. This combination of ingredients makes it a great option for people looking to address dryness, and dehydration and improve overall skin texture, remaining on a budget all the while.

“I love The Ordinary for its straightforward and effective ingredient list,” Holly J Coley, commerce deputy editor, shared. “My skin is incredibly dry — like, so dry that I use a facial oil and moisturizer or a regular basis. I found that this hyaluronic acid made it so that I didn’t have to put layer after layer of other products on, which was huge.”

She applied it to a damp face (typically after her shower) and was happy to notice it absorbed in about a minute. “It left my skin dewy, soft, and with a noticeable bounce,” she added.

One of the key benefits of this serum is its ability to provide immediate hydration, leaving the skin feeling smooth and soft. It works by replenishing moisture in the skin’s outer layers, preventing water loss and improving elasticity. The lightweight, non-greasy texture absorbs quickly, making it easy to layer with other skincare products, such as moisturizers and sunscreens. Since it doesn’t leave a sticky or heavy residue, it’s ideal for both daytime and nighttime use.

Despite its simplicity, The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Serum stands out for its efficacy and affordability. The brand is known for offering high-quality, science-backed products at accessible price points, and this serum is no exception. Better yet, it doesn’t contain any unnecessary fillers or fragrances, making it a great option for those with sensitive skin or anyone looking for a no-frills approach to skincare.

Size: 1 ounce | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Glycerin | Pairs well with: The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA ($14)

The Naturium Quadruple Hyaluronic Acid Serum 5% doesn’t only hydrate but provides multi-level moisture. In its formulation, it blends four different forms of hyaluronic acid, each one targeting different layers of the skin for maximum effectiveness.

The higher 5% concentration delivers a more potent dose of hydration than the rest of the industry’s litter, making it a powerful option for addressing dryness and dehydration.

“I’ve been using the Naturium Quadruple Hyaluronic Acid Serum 5% for a bit now, and I’m actually impressed with the results,” Kendall Cornish, former commerce writer/editor, shared. “The gel-like texture absorbs quickly into my (seriously dehydrated) skin, leaving it feeling plump, but without any sticky residue.”

If Naturium’s hyaluronic acid serum wasn’t enough of an overachiever, it also includes vitamin B5 (panthenol), which helps to soothe and support the skin’s natural barrier. This makes the serum suitable for a wide range of skin types, including sensitive and irritated skin.

To top if off, this serum holds a lightweight, non-greasy texture that absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving a refreshed, soft feel without any residue; this makes it seamless to layer with other skincare products in your regimen.

The hyaluronic acid serum is also formulated without parabens, sulfates or artificial fragrances, making it a clean and gentle option for those who are mindful of ingredient transparency. Its packaging features a sleek, air-tight pump bottle that helps preserve the potency of the active ingredients while making it easy to dispense the right amount of product.

Size: 1 ounce | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Vitamin B5, Glycerin | Pairs well with: Naturium Dew-Glow Moisturizer SPF 50 ($22)

The Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Serum is an excellent choice for oily skin due to its lightweight, non-comedogenic formula, which hydrates without clogging pores. Oily skin can sometimes become dehydrated, leading to an overproduction of oil as the skin compensates for the lack of moisture. With a well-designed formulation that keeps hyaluronic acid as the mainstay ingredient, it ensures the skin stays hydrated throughout the day without feeling greasy or heavy. It also balances oil production, preventing the skin from becoming excessively oily or dry.

Neutrogena Hydro Boost Serum has a gel-like consistency that absorbs quickly into the skin, providing a smooth, refreshed feel without leaving a residue. This makes it ideal for daily use, even under makeup, as it creates a hydrated yet matte surface.

“The Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Serum has been a really lovely addition to my (admittedly somewhat sparse) skincare routine,” Angela Tricarico, commerce streaming reporter, shared. “I started using it in tandem with the Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Water Gel Cream and have seen a notable difference in my skin, which tends to be drier in the winter months.”

What’s more, the parts of Tricarico’s skin that are normally the driest are nice and soft, and her t-zone has been less oily since she started using this serum daily.

Neutrogena’s hyaluronic acid serum is designed to deliver long-lasting moisture, ensuring that the skin remains balanced and comfortable without triggering breakouts or excessive shine. It supports skin barrier function without exacerbating oiliness, and you’ll also appreciate how it’s enriched with glycerin, which helps retain water within the skin, while also offering antioxidant properties to protect the skin from environmental stressors. This makes the serum effective for maintaining skin health and preventing irritation or inflammation that can often occur in oily, and even acne-prone, skin.

Size: 1 ounce | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Vitamin B5, Glycerin | Pairs well with: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Gel Cream ($23)

The Three Ships Dew Drops Mushroom + Kakadu Plum + Hyaluronic Acid Serum is a lovely choice for sensitive skin due to its carefully selected, soothing ingredients designed to calm and hydrate without causing irritation. It’s distinctive for its inclusion of Tremella extract — a hyaluronic acid alternative — that has the potential to penetrate the epidermis (the outer layer of the skin, that is) deeper because of its smaller particle size compared to traditional hyaluronic acid.

Mushroom extract, one of the key ingredients, marries with Tremella extract to deliver powerful anti-inflammatory properties to reduce redness, irritation, and inflammation, which are common concerns for sensitive skin types. This makes the serum ideal for individuals who experience reactive skin or conditions like rosacea or eczema, as it helps restore balance without exacerbating sensitivity.

In addition to mushroom extract, the serum also contains Kakadu plum, which is rich in vitamin C and antioxidants. As we know, vitamin C is a superstar for its brightening effects and, in this formula, Kakadu plum helps to protect the skin from environmental stressors while promoting a more even complexion

“I’m majorly impressed by the results and quality of this serum and its all-natural ingredients,” Meaghan Seward, senior strategist of commerce audience optimization and discovery, shared. “I started testing this product just when my skin needed it most; I was just getting over a bad cold, and the cold of the winter was really starting to set in in December. My skin absorbed all the hydration it so desperately needed, leaving it clear, plump and rejuvenated.”

The best part, per Seward, is how well this serum layers with other products in her routine. “At first, I noticed a slight smell from the mushroom extract, but given that it’s natural rather than artificial fragrance, this really didn’t bother my sensitive skin,” she shared. “After all, these ingredients allow for the product to be 100% vegan, cruelty-free, gluten-free and pregnancy safe. It’s worth noting that it also contains vitamin C to help brighten skin tone, but should always be supported with SPF to protect your skin.”

The lightweight, non-greasy texture of this serum ensures it absorbs quickly without leaving a heavy residue, making it ideal for sensitive skin that is prone to feeling overwhelmed by thicker formulations. Together, these ingredients work synergistically to hydrate, protect and calm, making it a great addition to a sensitive skincare routine.

Size: 1 ounce | Key ingredients: Tremella extract (hyaluronic acid alternative), Kakadu plum, Red algae extract | Pairs well with: Three Ships Restore Ceramides + Gotu Kola Barrier Repair Cream ($37)

The Good Molecules Hyaluronic Acid Serum serves those with acne-prone skin due to its lightweight, noncomedogenic formula that delivers effective hydration without clogging pores. As imagined, one of the key challenges for individuals with acne is maintaining proper hydration while avoiding products that may contribute to breakouts or excess oil production. Unlike heavier creams or oils that can exacerbate acne by trapping bacteria or oil in the pores, the serum absorbs quickly and leaves the skin feeling refreshed and plump without any greasy residue. No congested skin here.

“If you’re looking for a kicked-up hyaluronic acid formula, Good Molecules is a great choice,” Miska Salemann, commerce reporter, shared. “It incorporates two forms of hyaluronic acid with different molecular weights, allowing it to penetrate the skin further for a deeper, total hydration. My favorite part about this formula is that it doesn’t require long-term use to start noticing results; your skin starts looking and feeling more hydrated right away.”

Given that this is a stronger formula, Salemann was slightly nervous there would be some stinging when she applied it, but she didn’t notice anything of the sort. “It went on quite gently and my skin seems softer, brighter, more subtle and plumped in the right places,” she added. “With time, I’d expect it would help smooth out some fine lines, too.”

Besides its ability to hydrate, the serum also helps to balance the skin’s moisture levels, which is crucial for acne management. Often, acne treatments like salicylic acid or benzoyl peroxide can dry out the skin, leading to an imbalance where the skin compensates by producing even more oil. This can create a cycle that worsens acne. As a helpful agent, the Good Molecules Hyaluronic Acid Serum can break this cycle by replenishing moisture without triggering an overproduction of oil because of its inclusion of hyaluronic acid and lightweight properties.

The Good Molecules serum boasts a formula that’s void of harsh additives like parabens, sulfates or artificial fragrances, which can irritate sensitive, acne-prone skin. It also features a non-greasy formula that plumps at the same time which may mitigate the appearance of subtle acne scars due to its water-drenched aftereffect. ;

Size: 1 ounce | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Glycerin | Pairs well with: Good Molecules Lightweight Daily Moisturizer ($12)

After reviewing the lion’s share of La Roche-Posay, I can attest that its Hyalu B5 Pure Hyaluronic Acid Serum is a sent-from-above blessing for skin that needs some TLC. Hyaluronic acid aside, this serum contains vitamin B5 (panthenol), which has healing and anti-inflammatory properties that help to strengthen the skin’s barrier, reduce irritation and accelerate the skin’s natural repair process. In short, it’s a dreamboat for redness.

My skin is mostly dry and sensitive. I’m sometimes prone to redness near the apples of my cheeks. To prevent them from *actually* turning Snow White-apple red, I turn to La Roche-Posay’s nurturing formula that holds a one-of-a-kind cooling effect. The synergistic duo of hyaluronic acid and vitamin B5 works to restore moisture, soothe and calm redness caused by environmental stressors or underlying skin conditions like rosacea or eczema.

Big picture thinking now: La Roche-Posay’s commitment to using minimalist approach with dermatologically tested ingredients is crucial for those with sensitive or redness-prone skin. The serum is free from harsh fragrances, parabens and other potential irritants. I love how it’s lightweight it feels. All the while, it visibly reduces redness and has noticeably improved my overall skin tone. It’s exceptional if you’re craving a more even, calm, healthier complexion.

Size: 1.01 ounces | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Vitamin B5 | Pairs well with: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Double Repair Face Moisturizer ($24)

Dermatologists love it, and we do, too. The CeraVe Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Serum is a lightweight, fast-absorbing serum designed to provide deep hydration and support the skin’s natural moisture barrier. It’s ideal for those with dry or dehydrated skin, and it works well for all skin types.

“I have acne-prone combination skin and Cerave is one of the few brands that has had my back over the years,” Salemann said. “The Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Serum is super gentle and works wonders. Even a small amount goes a long way for hydration.”

With her skin being dry in the winter, applying this serum helps bring it back to life. “My face feels baby soft (like just-had-a-facial-soft), for the whole day,” she added. “I wouldn’t recommend it for someone living in a more humid or dewy climate, but for an East Coast winter — it’s an absolute everyday essential.”

This serum is formulated with three essential ceramides, which help to reinforce the skin’s natural barrier, ensuring that moisture stays locked in for longer periods; this helps to reduce moisture loss and prevent external irritants from penetrating the skin. It’s noncomedogenic, fragrance-free and dermatologist-tested, making it a soothing refresher before bedtime, though you can also use it in the morning.

The serum is also non-greasy and lightweight, allowing it to layer easily under other treatments without feeling heavy or sticky. Whether you’re looking for a boost of hydration or seeking to improve the overall appearance and texture of your skin, it’s a great option for balancing hydration levels.

Size: 1 ounce | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Ceramides, Glycerin | Pairs well with: CeraVe Daily Moisturizing Lotion with Hyaluronic Acid & Ceramides ($19)

While I’m beyond obsessed with the COSRX Snail Mucin 96% Power Repairing Essence ($20), it can’t steal all of the spotlight. That’s where the brand’s equally as good Hyaluronic Acid Intensive Cream comes in. It’s a rich, deeply hydrating moisturizer formulated with a high concentration of hyaluronic acid, attracting moisture to keep skin plump, smooth and hydrated.

While it has a bit of a goopy consistency, it helps auto-correct your skin if it looks lackluster. I find that it’s perfect for my dehydrated skin, with the cream’s thick, luscious texture absorbing quickly without feeling heavy or greasy. I love using it in the mornings and evenings (following my Snail Mucin, of course).

Because it includes glycerin and niacinamide in addition to hyaluronic acid, its formulation further enhances the cream’s ability to hydrate and brighten the skin. The result? A radiant, refreshed appearance.

If the trifecta of ingredients wasn’t enough, the COSRX cream also contains panthenol (pro-vitamin B5), which has soothing properties and improves the overall skin texture, making it feel soft and nourished. Without fail, I consistently reach toward this light-as-air, whipped texture to layer over my serums — and it doesn’t pill!

If your skin runs sensitive, this hydrant is still for you. It’s void of parabens, sulfates and artificial fragrances and works well alongside other skincare products. Despite its rich texture, the cream doesn’t feel overly thick, which has benefits for combination skin, too. When used consistently, I noticed it offers my skin a pleasing, dewy glow.

Size: 3.52 ounces | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Niacinamide, Gylcerin, Vitamin B5 | Pairs well with: COSRX Hyaluronic Acid Hydra Power Essence Hyaluronic Acid Toner ($17)

After reviewing all of Charlotte Tilbury, its Magic Cream is one to rave about. First off, this hyaluronic acid cream is supremely luxurious with a melt-in-your-fingers consistency that leads to a soothing, smooth glow. It’s infused with ingredients like hyaluronic acid, aloe vera and peptides to deliver moisture deep into the skin, helping to reduce dryness each time I use it.

What sets Magic Cream apart from other moisturizers is its multitasking ability. Not only does it hydrate, but it also provides a radiant glow. On a scientific level, the formula contains light-reflecting particles that help create a soft, dewy finish, making it perfect for those who want a luminous complexion without the need for additional highlighters or makeup. While I don’t struggle with fine lines, the cream’s ability to smooth out any natural* imperfections* and create a glowing base has made it one I reach to routinely (following my hyaluronic acid serum, of course).

Though not 100% fragrance-free, it doesn’t irritate my skin and has an almost thin texture. As a result, I’m left with buildable coverage to spot-treat any dry spots in addition to smoothing out a clean layer all over my face. It’s a splurge but its tub is sure to last a while — and do your skin some good all the while.

Size: 1.01 ounces | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Vitamins C and E, Peptides | Pairs well with: Charlotte Tilbury Charlotte’s Magic Serum Crystal Elixir ($85)

The L’Oreal Paris Revitalift 1.5% Hyaluronic Plumping Serum hails from a heritage brand in the beauty industry that’s keen on addressing fine lines due to its high concentration of 1.5% hyaluronic acid. As the skin becomes more hydrated, fine lines appear less noticeable because they are less likely to become accentuated by dehydration. This leaves your complexion looking smoother and more youthful.

The serum contains other beneficial ingredients like Pro-Retinol (a derivative of vitamin A) and vitamin C, which are known to promote skin renewal and boost collagen production. This combination of ingredients works synergistically to target the signs of aging, including fine lines and wrinkles. Jacqueline Goldstein, VP of commerce, has been enjoying the product for targeting fine lines.

“The L’Oreal Paris Revitalift 1.% Hyaluronic Plumping Serum has a lot of good things going for it: it’s fairly low cost, scentless, uses very straightforward packaging and delivers the product in a dropper, and it’s accessibly sold at major retailers like Amazon and Walmart,” Goldstein noted. “I also recently learned Eva Longoria is a fan. After about two months using it, during the winter I might add, my face is hydrated and happy while the rest of my skin gasps for moisture… I will have to address elsewhere.”

If you have very sensitive skin, you might want to consider another product though, as there was a slight tingle upon application, according to Goldstein.

What’s more, the lightweight yet effective formula of this serum provides both immediate and long-term improvements in skin appearance, making it a must-buy for anyone with anti-aging concerns.

Size: 1.7 ounces | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Pro-Retinol, Vitamin C | Pairs well with: L’Oreal Paris Revitalift Triple Power Anti-Aging Moisturizer ($31)

If you’re *really* serious about your hyaluronic acid usage, then the SkinCeuticals Hyaluronic Acid Intensifier Multi-Glycan serum is worth the extra coin, namely because its advanced formulation goes beyond basic hydration.

Unlike traditional hyaluronic acid serums, this product features a potent blend of three different glycans, which are naturally occurring molecules that support the skin’s structural integrity and moisture balance. By combining these glycan compounds with 1.3% hyaluronic acid, the serum amplifies the skin’s ability to retain moisture and strengthens the skin’s barrier; this results in a plumping effect that visibly smooths fine lines and promotes a more youthful, radiant complexion.

In that regard, the multi-faceted approach to hydration and skin health makes it an investment for anyone serious about anti-aging skincare. The standout feature? Its ability to target multiple layers of the skin for deeper, long-lasting hydration. The coupling of hyaluronic acid with proven technology like glycan helps improve the skin’s moisture content not only on the surface but also in the deeper layers where hydration is often most needed. This makes it particularly beneficial for individuals with dry, dehydrated or aging skin.

“SkinCeuticals is revered by anyone who knows a thing about medical-grade skincare,” Coley said. “I’ve used HA products before but nothing as high-end. I love how silky the texture of this one is and how gentle.” She didn’t notice a huge difference, which was sort of a disappointment for the price tag. However, Coley’s skin was a bit brighter and her texture was slightly better.

While hyaluronic acid is still the superstar ingredient of this serum, it has other skincare technology (such as probiotics) to improve texture and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.

This remarkable, clinical-grade skincare product is also free from fragrances, parabens and dyes, making it suitable for sensitive skin types as well. The high-quality ingredients and attention to detail in the formulation ensure that you’re not just paying for the brand name, but for a product that can provide real, visible benefits.

Size: 1 fluid ounce | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, 10% proxylane solution (to help support skin firmness), 0.2% purple rice extract (known for their antioxidant properties) | Pairs well with: SkinCeuticals Renew Overnight Dry Moisturizer ($78)

The Ordinary Alpha Arbutin 2% + HA Hyperpigmentation Serum is a powerful yet affordable treatment for hyperpigmentation, primarily due to its high concentration of alpha arbutin. Alpha arbutin is a potent yet gentle brightening agent that works by inhibiting the enzyme tyrosinase, which is responsible for the production of melanin in the skin. By reducing melanin synthesis, alpha arbutin helps to fade dark spots, sun spots and hyperpigmentation more effectively than many other brightening ingredients, without causing irritation or sensitivity.

Additionally, the 2% concentration in this serum is enough to show visible improvements in skin tone, making it a go-to option for anyone struggling with uneven pigmentation or discoloration. And, let’s not forget, hyaluronic acid further enhances its efficacy by providing hydration and improving the skin’s moisture barrier.

“Wow” is the single word Michelle Moezam, senior commerce social media manager, used to describe this product once she used it on her skin. “My mom audibly gasped on FaceTime with me and said, ‘you’re glowing!‘ after I had been using this serum twice daily and consistently for 2 weeks,” Moezam said. “I struggle with hyperpigmentation and this has helped lift darkness from any post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation I may get from an older deflated hormonal pimple.”

She said you can sense skin sensitivity a little bit when using this, so hydration layered on top (like one of the best night creams we reviewed) is key, as well as a daily SPF. “I would caution using this alongside any other highly active serums; it may make your face feel hot and overwhelm the skin,” she noted.

For its thoughtfully curated ingredient list, it’s a product suitable for those with dry or dehydrated skin, which can often exacerbate the appearance of hyperpigmentation. The combination of brightening and hydrating properties makes this serum ideal for treating hyperpigmentation while ensuring that the skin remains healthy and balanced throughout the process.

Unlike some hyperpigmentation treatments that can feel heavy or greasy on the skin, this serum absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave a sticky residue. This makes it easy to layer with other products, such as moisturizers or sunscreen, without feeling uncomfortable. The serum is also well-suited for use in both morning and nighttime skincare routines. Consistent application over several weeks is thought to lead to visible improvements in skin tone, clarity, and a reduction in the appearance of dark spots.

Size: 1.01 ounces | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Alpha arbutin | Pairs well with: The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA ($14)

When makeup brands include hyaluronic acid in an ingredient list, you know you’ll receive an extra dose of hydration. Luckily, that’s exactly what’s inside the MILK MAKEUP Hydro Grip Primer.

Much like your go-to hyaluronic acid serum, this primer doesn’t feel heavy or greasy. Rather, it securely grips onto makeup following it, preventing smudging or fading even in humid conditions. For that reason, it’s incredibly revered in the beauty community — and one of the most refreshing ones we often turn to.

“I have sensitive, dry skin, so I typically use a thick moisturizer as a primer before my makeup,” Brooke Matalon, Page Six social media editor, shared, along with her experience of testing the product. “Because of that, I was skeptical about trying this, but I was really impressed by how hydrating yet tacky it is. The gel-like formula really kept my foundation securely in place all day.”

The primer dries down to a slightly tacky finish, which enhances the adherence of foundation, concealer and other makeup products. In addition to hyaluronic acid, it includes aloe water to soothe the skin and create a plump, healthy look at the same time. This dual-action approach makes it ideal for those who (1) want skincare-esque hydration and (2) makeup longevity.

Not only that, this hyaluronic acid-infused primer is also clean, vegan and cruelty-free, making it a top-tier sustainable buy. It also includes niacinamide and hemp-derived cannabis-seed extract (to help lock in moisture), in addition to blue agave extract that grips makeup to prevent melting, fading and caking.

Its green-tinted gel blends transparently into the skin as well, giving it a universally flattering look on all skin tones.

Size: 1.52 ounces  | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Aloe water, Hemp-derived cannabis-seed extract (to help lock in moisture) | Pairs well with: MILK MAKEUP KUSH Sheer Hydrating Lip Oil ($26)

The MILK MAKEUP Hydro Grip Set + Refresh Spray is a well-formulated setting spray that offers both long-lasting and hydrating benefits. The reason? It includes both hyaluronic acid and niacinamide — the combo made in heaven — to help maintain moisture balance while locking in makeup at the same time.

One of the standout features of the Hydro Grip Spray is its ability to create a smooth, dewy finish without the greasy feeling that some setting sprays leave behind. The unique formula is designed to grip makeup, providing long-lasting hold even under high humidity or after hours of wear. Its lightweight, non-aerosol mist offers an even and fine spray, allowing for a refreshed look without disrupting the makeup you’ve carefully applied. This makes it perfect for quick touch-ups or setting makeup in place after a full application.

“This is such a great setting spray that really brings your makeup look together,” Matalon shared. “It’s dewy without making you look shiny, and it works to keep your makeup in place. I have drier skin, and I found it to be super hydrating.”

Another key benefit of this clear hyaluronic acid setting spray is its versatility. Not only does it set makeup, but it can also be used throughout the day to revitalize the skin and give it a refreshed, hydrated glow. Whether you’re transitioning from day to night or simply need a midday boost, this spray works wonders in reinvigorating your complexion.

And, like the brand’s Hydro Grip Primer, it contains blue agave extract to set makeup to prevent melting, fading and creasing.

Size: 3.38 ounces | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, Blue agave extract | Pairs well with: MILK MAKEUP KUSH Sheer Hydrating Lip Oil ($26)

The INKEY List Hyaluronic Acid Serum is a standout product for improving skin texture due to its deeply hydrating and plumping properties. Its pure hyaluronic acid content provides intense hydration and helps to soften the skin’s surface, reducing the appearance of dryness, flakiness, and other textural issues. Not to mention, when the skin is adequately hydrated, it naturally appears plumper and more even, which can lead to a smoother overall texture.

Another reason the serum is great for texture is its lightweight, fast-absorbing formula. Unlike some heavier moisturizers or oils, The INKEY List Hyaluronic Acid Serum doesn’t leave behind a greasy residue, making it suitable for all skin types, including oily or acne-prone skin. It absorbs quickly into the skin, allowing for immediate hydration without disrupting the skin’s natural barrier or contributing to breakouts. By delivering moisture deep into the skin without clogging pores, the serum helps to balance out texture irregularities caused by dehydration, oil buildup or acne scars.

“As someone who firmly believes good skincare — especially the basics — shouldn’t break the bank, I was really excited to try The Inkey List’s much-hyped hyaluronic acid serum — and I wasn’t disappointed!” Elana Fishman, Page Six Style and shopping director, said. “My skin’s always dry, but it gets particularly parched during the winter and this added a nice boost of hydration when layered beneath my usual moisturizer.”

It didn’t feel sticky on her skin, either (a common complaint with hyaluronic acid serums) and seemed to absorb nicely, leaving her complexion looking and feeling plump and nourished. “I haven’t noticed any breakouts or irritation after about a month of testing it, either, and my skin’s fairly sensitive,” Fishman added. “Do be careful when dispensing it; you only need a few drops to get the job done, and the packaging makes it easy to pour out too much at once. But again, at $10 a bottle, it’s not the end of the world if you go through it quickly!”

Additionally, the INKEY List Hyaluronic Acid Serum works synergistically with other skincare products to improve overall skin texture. When used as part of a consistent skincare routine, it enhances the effectiveness of exfoliating acids or treatments that target uneven skin tone or surface texture. The serum’s ability to keep skin hydrated creates an optimal environment for these active ingredients to work more effectively, leading to smoother, more refined skin over time.

To add the cherry on top of the skincare sundae, this serum contains a multi-molecular form of hyaluronic acid which penetrates deeply into the skin’s surface to provide additional nourishment. The serum is also vegan, cruelty-free and fragrance-free — a checkmark in its favor for the most sensitive skin types.

Whether you’re dealing with fine lines, dry patches or acne scars, this serum provides the hydration necessary to support skin’s natural renewal process. The end result? A visibly smoother, more even complexion when consistently used.

Size: 1.0 ounce | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Glycerin | Pairs well with: The INKEY List Bio-Active Ceramide Moisturizer ($20)

The DRMTLGY Barrier Repair Mask is a standout product because it is specifically designed to strengthen and restore the skin’s natural barrier. It contains the nourishing-ingredient trifecta — ceramides, peptides and hyaluronic acid — all of which work together to support the skin’s moisture retention and repair damaged or compromised skin. Combined, these ingredients help replenish lipids, improve hydration and enhance the skin’s ability to protect itself from external stressors like pollution, weather changes and harsh skincare products.

By focusing on barrier repair, this mask is ideal for those with dry, sensitive or irritated skin, or anyone dealing with the aftermath of over-exfoliation or environmental damage. It also provides instant relief and long-term benefits. Upon application, the mask has a soothing and cooling effect, which helps calm inflammation and redness, magically. The rich, creamy texture deeply moisturizes, leaving the skin feeling soft and smooth, without being heavy or greasy. Over time, regular use of the mask strengthens the skin’s protective barrier, leading to more resilient skin that is better equipped to handle dryness, sensitivities and external aggressors.

“As a dry-skinned girlie, I absolutely love the DRMTLGY Barrier Repair Facial Mask for its ultra-rich, hydrating formula, which leaves my skin feeling silky smooth and deeply nourished overnight (literally),” Cornish shared. “I find this mask to be a game-changer when it comes to effectively repairing my skin barrier through the winter and reducing redness without any added irritation.”

Additionally, it’s a great treatment for restoring balance to the skin, leaving it looking healthier and more radiant. What sets the DRMTLGY Barrier Repair Mask apart from other face masks is its clean and effective formulation as well. It’s void of parabens, sulfates and fragrances and designed to be gentle on the skin, even for those with the most sensitive or reactive skin types. The mask is also suitable for all skin types, from dry and mature skin to oily and acne-prone skin, as it hydrates without clogging pores. It’s a luscious, practical solution to implement into your skincare regimen at least once a week.

Size: 1.65 ounces | Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid, Peptides, Ceramides, Shea Butter, Jojoba seed oil, Aloe, Vitamin E | Pairs well with: DRMTLGY Peptide Night Cream ($46)

Consider this your skincare masterclass. Below, find the 411 on hyaluronic acid: what it is, how to use it and best practices for integrating the ingredient into your skincare routine.

“Hyaluronic acid (H.A.) is a polysaccharide (sugar string) substance found naturally in human skin, eyes, and joints, which acts as a natural lubricant, volume support and moisturizer,” Jessica Krant, MD, MPH, a board-certified dermatologist at NYC’s Laser & Skin Surgery Center told the New York Post. “It’s the material that surrounds and supports collagen in our skin.”

What’s more, it’s a staple ingredient for hydration due to its properties. “The key benefit of hyaluronic acid is its ability to bind water,” Adarsh Vijay Mudgil, MD, a dual board-certified dermatologist and founder of NYC’s Mudgil Dermatology PC, told The Post. “It can bind 1,000 times its weight in water, making it an ideal moisturizer.”

As mentioned above, there are plenty of hyaluronic acid benefits, as the ingredient, when incorporated, makes for an incredible moisturizer and serum for rejuvenated skin. “In topical products, it also helps make the skin surface more ‘translucent’ to other products, helping them penetrate more effectively through the skin surface barrier,” Dr. Krant adds.

It can also act as a humectant, drawing moisture from the air and holding it against the skin.

Ahead, our dermatologist experts share the 411 on how to use hyaluronic acid.

According to Dr. Mudgil, a topical preparation can be used daily to multiple times per day depending on one’s skin type.” Those with dry skin can use H.A. products more frequently without issue, too.”

Because it’s a natural substance, it’s also well-tolerated by just about everyone. “There’s really no skin type that can’t use it,” Dr. Nazarian noted. “Even super sensitive skin can use this ingredient safely and can use it daily, even several times a day. It can be used around the eyes and shows improvement within minutes —  super quickly. Ideally, it’s used with an emollient or something to seal the skin barrier to enhance its effects; humectant plus emollient is the perfect combo.”

Nazarian loves it best for dry skin and acne-prone skin, especially when paired with an emollient. “People with early signs of aging, like fine lines, can also benefit from using hyaluronic acid because it can minimize those lines very nicely, even within a few hours,” she highlighted. “Additionally, I like suggesting hyaluronic acid for people that are on a skincare regimen that may be somewhat irritating (such as acne regimens).”

“It’s absolutely okay to combine hyaluronic acid with retinol, vitamin C or niacinamide; it’s a perfect complement to these ingredients,” Nazarian said. “It does not work to treat acne as a monotherapy, and I would never recommend it as such. On the flip side, it doesn’t clog pores or cause acne, so it’s perfectly safe to use for acne-prone skin.”

The percentage of hyaluronic acid to use largely depends on your skin type and tolerability. For instance, if you have more sensitive skin, you’ll want to use a lower percentage, like 0.5%. However, if you’re not a newbie to hyaluronic acid or find your skin to be a veteran of many serums, you can use between 1% to 2%.

When researching hyaluronic acid skincare products before testing, we noticed that some brands highlighted if a formulation was a low-molecular-weight, high-molecular-weight or multi-molecular.

“Hyaluronic acid is found naturally in our tissue, mostly in a high molecular weight form, although it does get broken down and is found as a low-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid as well,” Nazarian explained. “The different weights may signal different cellular responses in the skin, triggering different pathways of healing and repair mechanisms, but they also have varying levels of penetration into the skin, meaning, you find different types in different areas and levels of the skin and body.”

So, the thought is that perhaps using a combination of molecular weights will trigger different complementary pathways and will lead to even better results than just high molecular weight alone. Generally, a low-molecular weight can penetrate deeper into the skin, but may also be more irritating. Higher-molecular weight stays on the surface for hydration.

“Plus, we know that the larger the size, the harder it is to penetrate into the skin, and we also know that too small may actually have harmful effects on the tissue. So it’s alllll about balance,” she commented.

Somewhat surprisingly, companies are not really stating what level of molecular weight they’re using in their products. But, Nazarian (and The Post Shopping team) thinks this is a trend that we should be looking for in the future.

Based on our testing, the most effective hyaluronic acid serum is the Drunk Elephant B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum for its ability to douse the skin in hydration and alleviate dry, flaky skin.

We also recommend The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Serum if you’re on a budget, and the SkinCeuticals Hyaluronic Acid Intensifier Multi-Glycan if you’re willing to splurge a bit more.

news.content: موارد بیشتری از پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. قبلاً آن را دیده‌اید - آگهی تبلیغاتی مراقبت از پوست که در آن شخصی با شادی آب را روی صورت خود می‌پاشد، معمولاً درست قبل از اینکه روی صفحه نمایش عبارت «اسید هیالورونیک» را به صورت پررنگ چشمک بزند. آن تصویر آب امضا؟ فقط برای نمایش نیست بهترین سرم‌های اسید هیالورونیک برای انجام آن کاملاً نشان داده می‌شود: آبرسانی، حجیم و طراوت پوست شما مانند یک لیوان آب بلند برای صورت شما. بنابراین، واقعا اسید هیالورونیک چیست؟ با وجود نام کمی ترسناک، این یک ماده شیمیایی خشن نیست. در واقع، این ماده ای است که به طور طبیعی در پوست، مفاصل و چشم شما یافت می شود. اسید هیالورونیک به عنوان یک مرطوب کننده قوی، رطوبت را از محیط جذب می کند و آن را در پوست شما محبوس می کند - و آن را به یک عنصر ضروری در بسیاری از مرطوب کننده ها، سرم ها و حتی بالم لب تبدیل می کند. نتیجه؟ پوستی صاف و لطیف که سالم تر و مرطوب تر به نظر می رسد. فرقی نمی کند که چگونه از اسید هیالورونیک استفاده کنید، آیا هیالورونیک اسید باعث ایجاد آکنه می شود یا اینکه چگونه با نیاسینامید مقایسه می شود، نمی توان منکر همه کاره بودن این ماده شد. این مورد به طور یکسان مورد علاقه متخصصان پوست و دوستداران مراقبت از پوست است، و مزایای اسید هیالورونیک بسیار فراتر از آبرسانی است (به این فکر کنید: بافت پوست بهبود یافته، خطوط ریز به حداقل رسیده و حتی حمایت تسکین دهنده برای پوست های حساس یا مستعد آکنه). برای کمک به شما در انتخاب بهترین گزینه‌های موجود در بازار، محصولات با رتبه‌بندی برتر را گردآوری کرده‌ایم - از بهترین سرم کلی اسید هیالورونیک گرفته تا یک مومیایی لب ملایم، سرم شبانه و موارد دیگر. مهم نیست پوست شما تی

news.originalContent:
امانوئل مکرون، رئیس‌جمهور فرانسه، در سفری اعلام نشده برای ابراز «همبستگی»، وارد ریاض شد.

او نخستین رهبر غربی است که از زمان تشدید حملات حوثی‌های متحد ایران وارد عربستان سعودی می‌شود و با محمد بن سلمان ولیعهد دیدار خواهد کرد.

این بخشی از سفر رئیس‌جمهور فرانسه به کشورهای خلیج فارس است که با هدف تأمین نفت و گازوئیل و کاهش قیمت‌ها پس از اعتراضات خشونت‌آمیز بر سر افزایش سرسام‌آور هزینه‌های زندگی در فرانسه صورت می‌گیرد.

آقای مکرون که با انتقادهای سنگینی در فرانسه روبه‌روست به خبرنگاران گفت که «در حال انجام وظیفه خود» است و در «محل مأموریت» حضور دارد.

در بیانیه‌ای که دفتر ریاست جمهوری فرانسه پیش از ورود آقای مکرون به عربستان سعودی منتشر کرد، آمده بود که هدف از این سفر، «نشان دادن همبستگی فرانسه با پادشاهی عربستان سعودی در مقابل حملات حوثی‌ها به خاک این کشور و همچنین ادامه تلاش‌ها برای تأمین و متنوع‌سازی منابع هیدروکربنی است.»

امانوئل مکرون پیش از ورود به عربستان در قطر بود و آنجا اعلام کرد که فرانسه پرسنل و تجهیزات به بندر ینبع که پایانه نفتی بسیار مهمی در عربستان است اعزام کرده است.

خبر ورود آقای مکرون در حالی اعلام شد که ساعاتی پیش خبرگزاری‌ها از انفجار و ستون دود در نزدیکی فرودگاه عدن خبر دادند و حوثی‌های یمن گفتند که به یک پایگاه نظامی عربستان سعودی در بندر عدن حمله کرده‌اند.

حوثی‌ها در شبکه‌های اجتماعی از قول سرتیپ یحیی سریع، سخنگوی نظامی‌شان، گفتند که اتاق عملیات قرارگاه بدر را با یک موشک بالستیک هدف حمله «دقیق و مستقیم» قرار داده‌اند.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

شاهدان عینی از مشاهده دود درنزدیکی فرودگاه عدن خبر داده‌اند.

در همین حال، حوثی‌های یمن گفتند که امروز، چهارشنبه، هیچ پهپادی به سمت شهر مقدس مدینه پرتاب نکرده‌اند و هیچ عملیات نظامی هم در خاک عربستان سعودی انجام نداده‌اند.

این اظهارات حوثی‌ها پیش از اعلام حمله به عدن و در تکذیب بیانیه ائتلاف به رهبری عربستان سعودی بود.

ائتلاف به رهبری عربستان سعودی که با حوثی‌های متحد ایران می‌جنگد، امروز گفت که پنج پهپاد را رهگیری کرده است؛ از جمله پهپادهایی در منطقه مدینه.

ترکی المالکی، سخنگوی ائتلاف، در شبکه اجتماعی ایکس نوشت: «چهار پهپاد که به سمت پادشاهی پرتاب شده بودند، رهگیری و منهدم شدند.» او در پیام دوم رهگیری‌ها در منطقه شرقی و مدینه را اعلام کرد.

آقای المالکی مشخص نکرد چه کسی مسئول پرتاب این پهپادها بوده است. حوثی‌ها این خبر را تکذیب کردند و یحیی سریع گفت که امروز هیچ‌گونه عملیاتی «در عمق» خاک عربستان سعودی انجام نشده است.

عربستان سعودی دائم زیر حملات حوثی‌هاست، از جمله حمله‌ به فرودگاه بین‌المللی ریاض که مرگبارترین حمله به آن کشور در سال‌های اخیر بوده است.

مدینه، محل دفن پیامبر اسلام، حضرت محمد، و محل مسجدالنبی، در کنار مکه یکی از مقدس‌ترین شهرهای اسلامی به شمار می‌رود. حوثی‌ها وعده داده‌اند که به این شهرها حمله نکنند.

حوثی‌ها بیشتر بخش‌های شمال و ساحل شرقی دریای سرخ را در کنترل دارند و قصد دارند با تصرف تعز و حرکت به سمت عدن، این دو شهر استراتژیک را از کنترل ائتلاف به رهبری عربستان خارج کنند. اگر عدن سقوط کند یمن در عمل به دو بخشی شرقی و غربی تقسیم می‌شود.

حوثی‌ها مدتی است که تعز را محاصره کرده‌اند.

در خیابان‌های شهر تعز زباله‌ها انباشته شده است و ساکنان در صف گاز هستند و شهر در محاصره با کمبود کالاهای اساسی دست‌وپنجه نرم می‌کند.

به‌دلیل شدت جنگ حوثی‌ها و نیروهای دولتی یمن، امکان انتقال زباله‌ها وجود ندارد در نتیجه در خیابان سوزانده می‌شوند.

حوثی‌ها اوایل ماه اکتبر، با مسدود کردن جاده اصلی منتهی به جنوب و بندر عدن، تعز را محاصره کردند.

این وضعیت باعث آوارگی گسترده و وخیم‌تر شدن بحران انسانی شده است.

سازمان‌های امدادرسان از کمبود گسترده سوخت، مواد غذایی، دارو و آب آشامیدنی سالم خبر داده‌اند. برنامه جهانی غذا هفته پیش گفت که ذخایر آرد گندم در این شهر تقریبا به پایان رسیده است.

Nearly 45 years after starting her fashion brand in the garment district, Nicole Miller is still all-in on New York.

Four days a week, the designer treks from her Tribeca apartment to her Seventh Avenue office building — the same one where she built her fashion collection nearly 45 years ago.

Under Miller’s influence, New Yorkers began grabbing up the “boho chic” staples — hobo bags, wide-leg jeans, velvet slip dresses, and romantic, billowing blouses — that still influence American style today.

But before Miller built a brand worth nearly $700 million or dressed celebrities like Angelina Jolie and Beyoncé, she was like many high schoolers: making her clothes on a sewing machine at home in the Berkshires.

That led to studying at the Rhode Island School of Design, where classmates included future bohemian icons like David Byrne and Tina Weymouth of Talking Heads. After graduating in 1973, Miller beelined it to New York City.

“Where else would you go?” she asked — or score a one-bedroom Upper East Side apartment for $240 a month? (Fourth-floor walkups in the neighborhood now run about $3,500.)

Off-hours were spent at Studio 54, Max’s Kansas City, roller-skating at The Roxy, and attending Andy Warhol’s blind-date dinners at The Odeon, where everyone brought a blind date for someone else. Miller became part of that artistic downtown scene through her college friends, meeting the pop art king through photographer Paige Powell.

After early gigs as a design assistant, Miller joined the New York dress company P.J. Walsh, where she first met Bud Konheim, a brutally frank and fast-talking executive.

Though Miller was generally soft-spoken and relaxed, she found they made a good business pair, and in 1982, the duo quit their jobs to launch her namesake company. Konheim scraped together $100,000 from family and friends, and Miller pitched in $15,000 from her personal savings.

The risk was worth it: The brand struck gold in its first year with an easy-to-wear dress that flattered the body by draping easily across the waist, appearing almost belted at the hips. Her knack for making women feel relaxed but glamorous took off, and she racked up $5 million in sales in the first year.

Meanwhile, Miller was hitting the town with friends Jay McInerney, author of Bright Lights, Big City, and Balthazar restaurateur Keith McNally. As for how she met her longtime friend Candace Bushnell, author of Sex and the City?

“Well,” Miller said, “Candace used to date my husband.”

All in all, “It was just fun. Everybody was drinking too much,” she said. “There were always some new trendy restaurants in New York. We were at The Odeon all the time along with the whole art world.”

Being in such creative company fueled Miller’s own vision, and after her first hit dress became a magnet for cheap knockoffs, she imagined something new: designer ties for both men and women.

They took off in the late 1980s, when a security guard in Miller’s former Madison Avenue store wore a tie printed with ticket stubs to his night job at the Metropolitan Opera. A Met staffer noticed the flashy neckwear, and the historic music hub soon placed a hefty order for its gift shop.

Within two years, Miller’s novelty neckties became a $12 million business, with brands like Frito Lay and Veuve Clicquot wanting to collaborate. “In the beginning, nobody was territorial about their logos,” Miller said. “But with the candy tie” — a bestselling design featuring chocolate snacks hand-drawn by Miller and her team on silk — “we had M&M’s, Hershey’s, Nestlé, and Mars. They were like, ‘Thank you for making us a tie, but next time don’t put us with our competitors.’”

Miller’s booming tie business unexpectedly led to love. After a meeting with Absolut about their own custom cravats, one executive cajoled Miller into making her first-ever wedding gown for his friend, along with a series of bridesmaid dresses.

“I couldn’t say no because it was Absolut Vodka,” Miller said with a laugh. At the wedding, she met her husband, Kim Taipale, a former investment banker and lawyer. They married in 1996, with former Mayor Rudy Giuliani officiating at City Hall. “We had Champagne and caviar afterward,” she said. “He was such a good mayor, and now he’s gotten so weird.”

When wedding trends loosened up, the designer started offering some of her evening dresses in white. Then shoppers started asking for some of her cocktail dresses for bridesmaids, so she whipped up a bridesmaid dress line. “We kept getting asked to do these things. It happened spontaneously,” she said.

Meanwhile, the tie revenue allowed her to spend more on runway shows and cast major 1990s supermodels like Naomi Campbell, Christy Turlington, and Linda Evangelista, turning the media spotlight on the designer.

“They were very serious about their profession. And they were always really nice. It’s funny, because some of the second-tier models were always a little attitude-y,” she said. (Ever the professional, Miller declined to name names, but did share that Tyra Banks was “one of the nicest models ever.”)

The supermodels’ Midas effect led to some celebrity dressing and wardrobing for movies and TV. Cardi B, Angelina Jolie, Kim Kardashian, Brad Pitt, and Kim Cattrall have worn the label.

The designer got famous enough to make her own Barbie doll, along with a luxe collection for The Price Is Right contestants. She’s also served as a judge for the Miss USA and Miss Universe pageants.

But in 2022, three years after her partner Konheim’s death, Miller decided it was time to take back some of her time. She sold a majority stake in the business and set up licenses for furniture, kitchenware, and beauty products. You probably have a Nicole Miller umbrella somewhere in your apartment.

But Miller soon realized she couldn’t avoid the style spotlight entirely.

In 2024, she started selling a new collection on QVC. A few times each month, she and her son Palmer Taipale, who works as her brand’s senior e-commerce and marketplace associate, go live on-air to front the label.

Sometimes, they even beam into their livestream from Miller’s Seventh Avenue showroom.

Nicole Miller’s brand turns 45 next year, but the designer is getting a jump on the milestone.

Today, she unveils a signature collection for the first time in three years. Some styles riff on old favorites — there are taxi cab prints and a strapless bandage dress made with the designer’s novelty neckties.

The designer has even reimagined her famous “baseball dress,” a sporty white tank dress with red stitching worn by Geena Davis to the 1992 premiere of “A League of Their Own.” The new version is longer, with sequins.

And Miller continues to feed off the city’s energy. She and her husband live in a 3,100-square-foot apartment that used to be three separate spaces — including the original apartment where she used to roller-skate around her living room on weekends. Their son also lives in the building.

“There’s just so much to be inspired by here, just walking around all of the different neighborhoods. If you’re a theater buff, you can go to the theater, or go to concerts and all kinds of things,” she said, continuing to scout new haunts. (Current favorites include Wild Cherry at A24’s Cherry Lane Theatre and Patsy’s Pizzeria in Harlem.)

Miller’s hard, enterprising work has also earned her a Sag Harbor manse, where the designer likes to waterski in the summer. She only recently stopped wakeboarding. (“If you wipe out, you wipe out hard,” she explained.) Friends include Countess Luann de Lesseps and Dexter producer Sara Colleton.

As for the company she’s built, Miller said, “I just look at it as, I’m still having a good time, and I’m enjoying what I’m doing.”

Expensive s—t that’s worth it, French edition.

Bethenny Frankel loves a drugstore find, so when she raves about a pricey beauty product, you know it’s the real deal. And when the “RHONY” legend recently posted about my favorite luxury French skin care brand, it was a true IYKYK moment.

In the Instagram Reel, the “Just B” podcast host shares that she is “obsessed” with the Yon-Ka Paris Vitamin C Serum.

“It goes on like a dream,” she says, raving that it could be her “new favorite serum.”

Made with 99.9% natural-origin ingredients, the formula helps lighten dark spots, brighten tone and boost radiance. It’s in an oily base that sinks right in — but leaves skin moisturized and supple all day. (Plus, as Frankel says, a little goes a long way.)

The “Just B” host follows the serum with the brand’s “invisible” SPF 50 Mineral Fluid Sunscreen, saying, “It hydrates, it’s not sticky, and it doesn’t burn your eyes.”

I understand why the entrepreneur loves the vitamin C serum so — I’ve used it so often that mine is nearly empty. C’est triste!

It costs $178 for a full bottle, making it one of the more expensive products I own — yet, it also earns my “worth it” status. I apply it with chilled cryo sticks in the morning for an unparalleled glow (and sensorial experience) that has people complimenting my skin more than ever. It’s perfect with gua sha as well.

While it’s rich enough to use alone in summer, as the weather cools, I layer it with Hydra N°1 Crème for the softest skin all day. Even better, the line is free of perfumes and chemicals that irritate my sensitive skin.

Used at luxury French spas like Printemps in Paris and New York City, Yon-Ka recently launched at major beauty retailers like Nordstrom and Ulta — so it’s about to become a well-known skin care staple stateside, too.

The other half of the sun care program Frankel’s “obsessed” with.

A hydrating, alcohol-free mist, seen on “Emily in Paris.”

A lightweight moisturizer that keeps even dry skin hydrated and soft all day.

پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود بیشتر ببینید. نسخه فرانسوی گران‌قیمت ارزشش را دارد. بتنی فرانکل عاشق یک داروخانه است، بنابراین وقتی در مورد یک محصول زیبایی گران بها می‌کند، می‌دانید که این محصول واقعی است. و هنگامی که افسانه "RHONY" اخیراً در مورد برند فرانسوی لوکس مراقبت از پوست من پستی منتشر کرد، این یک لحظه واقعی IYKYK بود. در حلقه اینستاگرام، مجری پادکست "Just B" به اشتراک می گذارد که او به سرم ویتامین C Yon-Ka Paris "وسواس" دارد. او می‌گوید: «مثل یک رویا ادامه می‌یابد،» او می‌گوید که می‌تواند «سرم جدید مورد علاقه‌اش» باشد.
این فرمول که با 99.9 درصد مواد منشا طبیعی ساخته شده است، به روشن شدن لکه های تیره، روشن شدن رنگ و افزایش درخشندگی کمک می کند. این در یک پایه روغنی است که مستقیماً در آن فرو می‌رود — اما پوست را در تمام طول روز مرطوب و انعطاف‌پذیر می‌کند. (به‌علاوه، همانطور که فرانکل می‌گوید، کمی راه طولانی را طی می‌کند.) میزبان «Just B» سرم را با کرم ضدآفتاب مایع معدنی «نامرئی» این برند با SPF 50 دنبال می‌کند و می‌گوید: «آب می‌کند، چسبنده نیست و چشم‌های شما را نمی‌سوزاند».
من می‌دانم که چرا کارآفرین آنقدر سرم ویتامین C را دوست دارد — من آنقدر از آن استفاده کرده‌ام که سرم تقریباً خالی است. این یک بطری کامل است! قیمت آن 178 دلار برای یک بطری کامل است، که آن را به یکی از گران‌ترین محصولات من تبدیل می‌کند — با این‌حال، وضعیت «ارزش آن» من را نیز کسب می‌کند. من آن را با کرایو استیک های سرد شده در صبح استفاده می کنم تا درخشندگی بی نظیری (و تجربه حسی) داشته باشم که باعث می شود مردم بیشتر از همیشه از پوست من تعریف کنند. با گوا شا نیز عالی است. در حالی که به اندازه کافی غنی است که به تنهایی در تابستان از آن استفاده کنید، چون هوا خنک می شود، لایه لایه می کنم

news.originalContent:
See more of our coverage in your search results.

The fantasy is here to stay.

Page Six Style has exclusively learned that the $50 million Fantasy Bra Kylie Jenner wore during the Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show 2026 is set to return to the Jacob & Co. NYC boutique, where it will be made available for private purchase.

In the past, most Fantasy Bras have been returned to the jeweler, disassembled, and made into various pieces of jewelry to be sold. Others have been put on display for fans to admire.

However, a representative for the brand told us Jenner’s bejeweled brassiere will remain intact for one lucky buyer.

It’s unclear if the price tag will remain at $50 million, but the bra could be invaluable to a certain buyer: Jenner herself.

Perhaps the multimillionaire makeup mogul might snap up the sparkly piece to commemorate her big catwalk moment; it’d also make a truly epic Christmas present from  boyfriend Timothée Chalamet or mom Kris Jenner, both of whom were cheering her on in the audience.

After all, the nearly four-pound piece was specifically made to fit Jenner’s “445 cc, moderate profile, half under the muscle, silicone” chest.

Whomever winds up spending the big bucks on the glittering lingerie will own a piece of history; this year’s VS show featured the event’s most expensive Fantasy Bra by far.

The previous record-holder was Gisele Bündchen’s Red Hot Fantasy Bra, which debuted in 2000 and was valued $15 million at the time — comparative chump change!

Jenner’s Jacob & Co. creation featured a 75.54-carat Fancy Vivid yellow diamond at its center, which alone is worth $22 million.

Another 4,409 diamonds totaling 1,373 carats make up the rest of the jewel-encrusted bra, each hand-set in a custom 18-karat gold mount.

NYC بازگردد، جایی که برای خرید خصوصی در دسترس قرار خواهد گرفت. و جواهرات مختلفی برای فروش درست می کنند. موارد دیگر برای تحسین طرفداران به نمایش گذاشته شده است. با این حال، یکی از نمایندگان این برند به ما گفت که سینه بند جواهرات جنر برای یک خریدار خوش شانس دست نخورده باقی می ماند. مشخص نیست که قیمت آن 50 میلیون دلار باقی بماند یا خیر، اما این سوتین می تواند برای یک خریدار خاص ارزشمند باشد: خود جنر. شاید غول آرایش مولتی میلیونر ممکن است این قطعه درخشان را برای بزرگداشت لحظه بزرگ راهپیمایی خود ببرد. همچنین یک هدیه کریسمس واقعاً حماسی از دوست پسر تیموتی شالامه یا مادرش کریس جنر می‌سازد، که هر دو در بین تماشاچیان او را تشویق می‌کردند. در نهایت، این قطعه تقریباً چهار پوندی به طور خاص برای تناسب با سینه‌های جنر «445 سی‌سی، نیمرخ متوسط، نیمه زیر ماهیچه، سیلیکون» ساخته شده بود. هر کسی که بخواهد پول هنگفتی را برای لباس زیر زنانه پر زرق و برق خرج کند، صاحب یک تکه تاریخ خواهد شد. نمایش امسال VS گران‌ترین سوتین فانتزی رویداد را به نمایش گذاشت. رکورددار قبلی، سوتین Red Hot Fantasy Gisele Bündchen بود که در سال 2000 عرضه شد و در آن زمان 15 میلیون دلار ارزش داشت — تغییر نسبتاً بزرگ!

news.originalContent:
US president has continued to support data centres in advance of midterms, despite growing opposition from Republicans.

United States President Donald Trump has said AI data centres should pay “dividends” to communities, in a shift before the midterm elections.

“If companies want to make their Data Centers popular, pay the community, and/or individuals within the community, a ‘dividend'” Trump said in a post on Truth Social on Wednesday.

The president’s comments come after he doubled down on his support for data centres, a stance seen as one of several political liabilities for Republicans in the run-up to the midterm election, as Trump’s approval rating has hit record lows.

Polls show dismal support for such centres amid concerns about the sprawling complexes’ water and energy use.

In the post, Trump advised companies that they could make the centres popular if they “pay the community, and/or individuals within the community, a ‘dividend’.”

“I have watched the process closely, and Data Centers that were highly unpopular in a certain area, have become extremely popular when a financial deal is struck,” he said. “MAKE DEALS, and get them built!!!”

Several top Republican candidates have opposed data centres before the midterm polls, with the issue emerging as an area of rare bipartisan consensus in advance of the November 3 vote.

Republican Senate candidates, including Ken Paxton in Texas, Mike Rogers in Michigan and John Husted in Ohio, have all called for more restrictions and oversight on the centres, in a reversal of earlier positions.

The issue featured prominently in a recent debate in Iowa, where Republican Senate Candidate Ashley Hinson said the local level should decide whether to build AI data centres.

Despite the shifting sentiment, Trump in late August issued an impassioned defence of data centres, decrying what he called “the anti-Data Center movement” as a gift to China.

“The only reason that communities throughout the USA should not want Data Centers is if they want to end up being backwards and poor,” Trump wrote at the time.

“If they want to be successful and rich, with far lower taxes and jobs all over the place, let Data Reign.”

Trump has taken several measures to accelerate data centre development, including issuing an executive order last year that called for measures to fast-track permitting and environmental review. The order promised to use federal land for the “expeditious and orderly development of data centers”.

Trump has also backed a voluntary pledge by AI companies to cover the full cost of the electricity data centres use, but has avoided supporting legally binding federal restrictions.

A Gallup poll conducted in March suggested that 71 percent of Americans opposed establishing AI data centres in their areas.

An ABC News/Washington Post/Ipsos poll released on Wednesday identified a similar rate of disapproval, with 72 percent of respondents saying that they opposed building new data centres in their communities.
news.content:
رئیس جمهور ایالات متحده علیرغم مخالفت فزاینده جمهوری خواهان، پیش از انتخابات میان دوره ای به حمایت از مراکز داده پیش از انتخابات ادامه داده است. دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور ایالات متحده گفته است که مراکز داده هوش مصنوعی باید در تغییری قبل از انتخابات میان دوره ای، به جوامع سود سهام پرداخت کنند. اظهارات رئیس جمهور پس از آن بیان می شود که او حمایت خود از مراکز داده را دو برابر کرد، موضعی که به عنوان یکی از چندین مسئولیت سیاسی جمهوری خواهان در آستانه انتخابات میان دوره ای دیده می شود، زیرا محبوبیت ترامپ به پایین ترین سطح خود رسیده است. در این پست، ترامپ به شرکت‌ها توصیه کرد که اگر «به جامعه و/یا افراد درون جامعه، «سود سهام» بپردازند، می‌توانند این مراکز را محبوب کنند.
او گفت: «من این فرآیند را از نزدیک تماشا کرده‌ام و مراکز داده که در یک منطقه خاص محبوبیت زیادی نداشتند، در صورت انعقاد یک معامله مالی بسیار محبوب شدند. "معاملات ببندید و آنها را بسازید!" چندین نامزد ارشد جمهوری خواه قبل از نظرسنجی میان دوره ای با مراکز داده مخالفت کرده اند، و این موضوع به عنوان منطقه ای از اجماع نادر دو حزبی پیش از رای گیری 3 نوامبر ظاهر شد. نامزدهای جمهوری خواه سنا، از جمله کن پکستون در تگزاس، مایک راجرز در میشیگان و جان هاستد در اوهایو، همگی خواستار محدودیت های بیشتر شده اند.

news.originalContent:
Russia will send on Thursday its first diesel tanker to the US to an undisclosed port.

Russia will send its first tanker of diesel fuel to the United States on Thursday, Russia’s Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak told reporters amid a deal with US President Donald Trump.

The vessel will have 40,000 tonnes of fuel, but Novak, who made his remarks on Wednesday, did not name which US port the fuel would be delivered to.

Russia lifted its ban on diesel exports on October 9, which Moscow originally put in place to tackle the country’s shortages as Ukrainian-led drone strikes hindered production capacity.

The shipment comes despite setbacks for Russia’s diesel output. Earlier this month, Ukraine’s Ministry of Defence said that drone strikes knocked out at least half of Russia’s oil refining capacity, forcing cuts at Russia’s top diesel-producing refineries.

“Additional shipments will follow, of course. There were agreements reached between the two leaders. We will meet the United States’ needs, to the extent of our capabilities,” the RIA Novosti news agency quoted Novak as saying.

That was echoed by US special envoy Steve Witkoff, who has been meeting Russian President Vladimir Putin for talks in St Petersburg.

“We are preparing deliveries of several vessels, the tankers, right now. They will go one after another. The financial component should be provided,” he said, adding that Russia would also be able to supply fertilisers in “large quantities” to the US market.

US President Donald Trump had previously said that Moscow would export 300,000 tonnes, or 2.25 million barrels, followed by 500,000 tonnes in November and 1 million tonnes “immediately thereafter”.

US consumers have continued to face high prices at the petrol station, particularly for diesel fuel, a pressing point as the country heads into midterm elections in less than two weeks. The average price for a gallon of diesel is $6.31 ($1.70 per litre), according to the American Automobile Association (AAA). While prices remain well over the $6 mark, they are on the downturn. The average price a month ago was $6.51.
news.content: الکساندر نواک معاون نخست وزیر روسیه در بحبوحه توافق با دونالد ترامپ رئیس جمهور آمریکا به خبرنگاران گفت: روسیه روز پنجشنبه اولین نفتکش دیزل خود را به ایالات متحده به بندری نامعلوم می فرستد. روسیه اولین تانکر سوخت دیزل خود را روز پنجشنبه به ایالات متحده ارسال خواهد کرد. روسیه ممنوعیت صادرات گازوئیل خود را در 9 اکتبر لغو کرد، که مسکو در ابتدا برای مقابله با کمبود این کشور وضع کرد زیرا حملات پهپادهای اوکراینی مانع از ظرفیت تولید شده بود. این محموله علیرغم مشکلاتی که برای تولید گازوئیل روسیه وجود داشت انجام می شود. در اوایل ماه جاری، وزارت دفاع اوکراین اعلام کرد که حملات پهپادی حداقل نیمی از ظرفیت پالایش نفت روسیه را از بین برده و باعث کاهش در پالایشگاه‌های برتر تولیدکننده گازوئیل روسیه شده است. خبرگزاری ریانووستی به نقل از نواک گفت: «البته محموله‌های بیشتری به دنبال خواهد آمد. توافق‌هایی بین دو رهبر انجام شد. ما نیازهای ایالات متحده را تا حد توانایی خود برآورده خواهیم کرد.» این موضوع توسط نماینده ویژه ایالات متحده، استیو ویتکاف، که با رئیس‌جمهور روسیه ملاقات کرده است، تکرار شد. آنها یکی پس از دیگری خواهند رفت. بخش مالی باید تامین شود.» وی افزود که روسیه همچنین می تواند کودهای شیمیایی را در «مقدار زیادی» به بازار ایالات متحده عرضه کند.
